cases.name: Add a column with a volatile default
cases.note: Existing rows are backfilled afterwards, in batches outside the migration.

unsafe.sql: ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN token uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid();

safe.sql:
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN token uuid;
ALTER TABLE users ALTER COLUMN token SET DEFAULT gen_random_uuid();

cases.name: Add a bigserial column
cases.note: The sequence default is attached after a batched backfill.

unsafe.sql: ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN seq bigserial;

safe.sql: ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN seq bigint;

cases.name: Change a column type
cases.note: The first step of expand and contract; the backfill and switch happen across later deploys.

unsafe.sql: ALTER TABLE users ALTER COLUMN counter TYPE bigint;

safe.sql: ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN counter_new bigint;
